description: An operator's number of scans is how many scan records they have.

a.request: For each operator (`scans.crewref`), find their number of scans by counting their scan records, and find their average file size per minute, computed per scan as `gbsize` ÷ `spanmin`. Ignore missing values. Consider only operators whose average GB per minute is above the simple average of that figure across all operators. In a single row, give the average number of scans of those operators, their average GB per minute, and their average margin above the all-operator average, with no rounding.
a.sql: WITH scan_metrics AS (SELECT crewref, gbsize / spanmin AS gb_per_minute FROM scans WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin > 0), operator_stats AS (SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) AS num_scans, AVG(gb_per_minute) AS avg_gb_per_minute FROM scan_metrics GROUP BY crewref), global_avg AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute) AS global_avg_gb_per_minute FROM scan_metrics), filtered_operators AS (SELECT os.num_scans, os.avg_gb_per_minute, os.avg_gb_per_minute - ga.global_avg_gb_per_minute AS margin FROM operator_stats os CROSS JOIN global_avg ga WHERE os.avg_gb_per_minute > ga.global_avg_gb_per_minute) SELECT AVG(num_scans) AS avg_num_scans, AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS avg_gb_per_minute, AVG(margin) AS avg_margin_above_overall FROM filtered_operators

c.request: Look at the operators (`scans.crewref`) whose average file size per minute, computed per scan as `gbsize` ÷ `spanmin` with missing values ignored, is above the simple average of that figure across all operators. In a single row, how many scans have these operators done on average, what is their average GB per minute, and by how much on average do they exceed the all-operator figure? Don't round. An operator's number of scans is how many scan records they have.
c.sql: WITH scan_metrics AS (SELECT crewref, CASE WHEN gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin > 0 THEN gbsize / spanmin ELSE NULL END AS gb_per_min FROM scans), operator_level AS (SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) AS total_scans, AVG(gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM scan_metrics GROUP BY crewref), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_min) AS overall_avg_gpm FROM scan_metrics WHERE gb_per_min IS NOT NULL), qualified_operators AS (SELECT ol.crewref, ol.total_scans, ol.avg_gb_per_min, oa.overall_avg_gpm FROM operator_level ol CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE ol.avg_gb_per_min > oa.overall_avg_gpm) SELECT AVG(total_scans) AS avg_scans, AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min, AVG(avg_gb_per_min - overall_avg_gpm) AS avg_excess FROM qualified_operators

b.request: Find operators with average (gbsize ÷ spanmin, nulls excluded) above global average; report average scan record count, average GB per minute, and average excess.
b.sql:
WITH global_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(gbsize / spanmin) AS avg_gb_per_min
  FROM scans
  WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin > 0
),
operator_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    crewref,
    AVG(scancount) AS avg_scancount,
    AVG(gbsize / spanmin) AS avg_gb_per_min
  FROM scans
  WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin > 0
  GROUP BY crewref
)
SELECT 
  os.crewref,
  os.avg_scancount,
  os.avg_gb_per_min,
  os.avg_gb_per_min - ga.avg_gb_per_min AS avg_excess
FROM operator_stats os
CROSS JOIN global_avg ga
WHERE os.avg_gb_per_min > ga.avg_gb_per_min
ORDER BY os.crewref
b.raw: Find operators with average (gbsize ÷ spanmin, nulls excluded) above global average; report average scan record count, average GB per minute, and average excess.

d.request: Operators whose mean GB-per-minute (computed per scan as gbsize ÷ spanmin, nulls ignored) exceeds the global mean GB-per-minute; for these operators, report their mean scan record count, mean GB-per-minute, and mean excess above the global figure.
d.sql: WITH scan_metrics AS (SELECT crewref, scancount, gbsize / spanmin AS gbpmin FROM scans WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin != 0), global_mean AS (SELECT AVG(gbpmin) AS global_gbpmin FROM scan_metrics), operator_means AS (SELECT crewref, AVG(scancount) AS mean_scancount, AVG(gbpmin) AS mean_gbpmin FROM scan_metrics GROUP BY crewref) SELECT om.crewref, om.mean_scancount, om.mean_gbpmin, om.mean_gbpmin - gm.global_gbpmin AS mean_excess FROM operator_means om CROSS JOIN global_mean gm WHERE om.mean_gbpmin > gm.global_gbpmin ORDER BY om.crewref
